CycleMania Thursday Night Mountain Bike Ride

Portland, ME · Mountain bike

CycleMania Thursday Night Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Portland, ME. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from CycleMania. Pace: all-inclusive. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all-inclusive. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the CycleMania Thursday Night Mountain Bike Ride group ride

An all-inclusive Thursday night ride on Portland's in-town trails, leaving from the shop. Bring a mountain bike; that's the only requirement. Call the shop with questions.
